markers.name: Tadapolia
says: Greetings, welcome to the bank... You are safe here.

markers.name: Ripple - AP Guard
says: Ripple> "No need to cringe in fear and watch the sky anymore. We have driven the invaders away."
Ripple> "Yes, this place is much more tranquil now that the foul presence of spirit creatures is no more."
Ripple> "Have you fought in the arena yet? It is great fun."

markers.name: Paddlefoot - AP Guard
says: Paddlefoot> "From here I can see for miles. The water can be dangerous."
Paddlefoot> "No Overking to watch out for. Our forces banished him to the Root of the Oracle. He wails there, sometimes at night."
Paddlefoot> "Most of our people are staying in the secret valley. That is fine, but I needed to see this fair land again. It will always be home to me."

markers.name: Roofus - BC Guard
says: Roofus> "Bo is the greatest leader we"ve had since Ataeus."
Roofus> "When we took back the Colonies, Bo was masterful in his attack."
Roofus> "The Overking that used to dwell here was ripped into raw essence and melted in Bo"s hands."

markers.name: Quoden - BC Guard
says: Quoden> "Don"t pay any attention to Kloeper in the hallway. He got hit on the head one too many times."

markers.name: Kloeper
says: Kloeper> "You know, I was a big part of the force that took back the colonies."
Kloeper> "Yes, I -- I -- I took on half of the spirit invaders myself. Heh heh, heh heh... yeah."
Kloeper> "The invaders were really tough and I almost died, but I killed them all."
